content.snl: thm-hyp(list-partial(Type.judge(@F, Analysis.PFun), Type.judge(list-partial(@a, @b, @C), Real), $#0 < #1$(a, b), Analysis.contOnIcc(F, a, b), $#0 < #1 \land #1 < #2$(Type.apply(Analysis.map(F), a), C, Type.apply(Analysis.map(F), b))), Logic.exists-typed(@c, Real, Logic.and(Set.mem(c, Icc(a, b)), Eq(Type.apply(Analysis.map(F), c), C))))

values.en:
A function continuous on `[a, b]` takes every value between `F a` and `F b`. Combined with the previous theorem this says the continuous image of a closed bounded interval is again a closed bounded interval.

The standard corollary is a root existence principle: a sign change over `[a, b]` forces a zero inside. The theorem is genuinely about the completeness of ℝ — the same statement over ℚ is false, as `x ↦ x² − 2` witnesses.
values.zh-CN:
在 `[a, b]` 上连续的函数取得 `F a` 与 `F b` 之间的每一个值。结合前一定理可知，闭有界区间的连续像仍是闭有界区间。

标准推论是根的存在性原理：在 `[a, b]` 上变号会迫使区间内存在一个零点。该定理本质上涉及 ℝ 的完备性——在 ℚ 上同一陈述为假，`x ↦ x² − 2` 即为反例。
